## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Prague, Czechia. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 4 km. It starts at World of Banksy Museum, Michalská, Old Town, Czechia. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Prague: World of Banksy Museum. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of history and art with tickets to World of Banksy Museum. This in-app audio tour invites history buffs and art lovers to delve into Prague's past and present, navigating through its picturesque streets and cultural landmarks. Experience the city's rebellious and creative spirit firsthand as you uncover tales of resistance, power, and vivid street artistry.
>
> Your journey begins at the vibrant World of Banksy, traversing the cobbled streets to witness the marvel of the Astronomical Clock, and diving into the depths of Prague's rich history. Intricate tales etched in ancient stonework will bring legends to life, from the eerie Dripstone Wall to the grandeur of Prague Castle and the spiritual quiet of St. Vitus Cathedral.
>
> Throughout this tour, you will walk steps laden with the quiet whispers of past lives, from the bustling Charles Bridge to the quaint serenity of Kampa Island. You will feel the pulse of royalty in Lobkowicz Palace and sense the literary echo of Kafka in his city. As you conclude your journey in Hradčany Square, you will carry with you a tapestry of stories and the visual feast of Prague's historical grandiosity, all witnessed through the eyes of generations past and present.
>
> While enjoying this self-guided walk, remember that an audio guide inside the World of Banksy Museum is not included, allowing you to savor the exterior as a prelude to the city’s intricate story.
